Lantern Quay

Free D&D 5e encounter

The Rope at Low Water

15–20 minutes · 3–5 level 3 characters · 2024 rules

The last ferry knocks against the jetty. A girl in an oilskin keeps one hand on the rail and reaches for a leather tool bag with the other. The rope beside her tightens against the current. From somewhere below the planks, a voice the size of a whisper says, “Iona.”

Put Iona in danger

The rope binds Iona Reed’s wrist and draws her towards a broken plank. Her sister Mara’s bag is just beyond it. Point out the mooring post, boat hook and ladder. Give everyone one chance to act. A plan that pins the rope and frees Iona works when its outcome is certain.

Run the rescue

  • Brace the line. A character holding the post or pulling with a boat hook can try a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. Success frees Iona and brings her onto the jetty.
  • Cross the broken boards. DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) to reach Iona on slick planks. Failure puts the rescuer prone at the ladder. They can stand and try an approach from the ladder or dry stone.
  • Cut the rope. The exposed rope has AC 11 and 6 hit points. Slashing damage can sever it. Iona can grab the ladder if the party warns her first.
  • Keep someone within reach. If the party fails to free Iona during the first exchange, she slips onto the ladder. A character who reaches the ladder and has a secure handhold can pull her up. Use a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check only if the rescuer is also under pressure from the line.

Give the clue

The bag holds Mara’s ferry token and a scrap reading MERCY / BERTH 7. A brass salvage tag on the rope has the same number. Give these clues when the characters search the bag or examine the rope. Iona tells them that Mara and the watch’s lamplighter vanished on successive nights, each after the bell rang.

Finish at the watch hut if you’re running this on its own. Iona offers the group free ferry passage when it reopens. To continue into The Bell Beneath the Docks, Iona points to the watch hut, salvage yard and north tide stairs.
